text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Trainer☆
I brought you some lucky news today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not,
a collaboration campaign
with "Tokyo Mega Illumi" is being held!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Word has it
Christmas presents are handed out
every single day, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like holding an event where we
bring the Christmas cheer—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You can tap the little gifts placed here
to receive items and goodies.
Looks like there are tons of fun festivities
in store!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's have fun together♪
Ricky☆ Lucky☆
Merry Christmas☆
